what: classification of the 5 open divergent cases gate 11 still misses, and a pre-named family of 5 second criteria tested against them, the 11 gates' own trajectories, and the convergent controls
gate_question: Does at least one pre-named criterion flag all 5 remaining divergent cases with zero false positives across the 11 existing gates, the 4 already-closed cases, and the well-behaved battery?
predicate_under_test: solver/marginal_flow.py:integrate -> rec['converged'] = finite(y) and no NaN break and worst_newton_residual_over_floor < 1e8 and state_growth < 1e5

criteria.C1: TAIL_GROWTH_RATIO: max_TAIL v / max_PRE v, per block, max over blocks
criteria.C3: MONOTONE_TAIL_FRACTION: fraction of TAIL steps with v increasing
criteria.C4: TAIL_RANGE_OVER_INITIAL_SCALE: (max_TAIL v - min_TAIL v) / initial scale
criteria.C5: TAIL_EFOLD_RATE: log(C1) / (mean tau of TAIL - mean tau of PRE)

mechanism_classification.name: mu_linear
mechanism_classification.explanation: genuinely unbounded but too slow to reach the 1e5 bound in the tau the run is given: growth 201, i.e. 0.00201 of the threshold, and only 0.495x above the module's own legitimate ceiling of 4.06e2.

mechanism_classification.name: b_quadratic
mechanism_classification.explanation: genuinely unbounded but too slow to reach the 1e5 bound in the tau the run is given: growth 3.73e+03, i.e. 0.0373 of the threshold, and only 9.18x above the module's own legitimate ceiling of 4.06e2.

mechanism_classification.name: osc_sustained
mechanism_classification.explanation: the state neither grows nor settles: growth 1 and tail range 0.278 of the initial scale.  A MAGNITUDE clause is the wrong instrument -- there is no magnitude to exceed.

mechanism_classification.name: osc_growing
mechanism_classification.explanation: the state neither grows nor settles: growth 1.99 and tail range 1.04 of the initial scale.  A MAGNITUDE clause is the wrong instrument -- there is no magnitude to exceed.

mechanism_classification.name: osc_stiff_underresolved
mechanism_classification.explanation: the computed trajectory does not diverge at all: amplitude retained 3.479e-14 of exact.  No state predicate can see what the stepper removed; this is a dt-vs-max|Im| hazard, not a gate-11 miss.

synthetic_battery.name: mu_linear
synthetic_battery.why: mu(tau) = mu0 + tau, unbounded; the mildest possible non-NaN divergence

synthetic_battery.name: mu_quartic
synthetic_battery.why: mu = (1+tau)^4, 7 decades of growth with a perfectly conditioned Newton

synthetic_battery.name: b_quadratic
synthetic_battery.why: Omega-block growth b = (1+tau)^2 with mu frozen: does the block matter?

synthetic_battery.name: mu_exp_mild
synthetic_battery.why: mu = 0.3 e^{tau/2}, 13 decades, still nowhere near overflow

synthetic_battery.name: mu_exp_extreme
synthetic_battery.why: mu = 0.3 e^{5 tau} ~ 1e129 at tau=60: 130 decades and STILL finite

synthetic_battery.name: mu_negative_runaway
synthetic_battery.why: mu -> -3e12: the documented 'finite but garbage' shape, made smooth
synthetic_battery.fidelity_criterion: fitted rate 0.5024 vs exact 0.5, and mu_end -3.745e+12 stayed negative

synthetic_battery.name: osc_sustained
synthetic_battery.why: pure rotation, 20 periods, |b| == 1 forever: no limit, never a NaN

synthetic_battery.name: osc_growing
synthetic_battery.why: rotation with Re = +0.05: oscillating AND unbounded

synthetic_battery.name: osc_stiff_underresolved
synthetic_battery.why: omega dt = 4 rad/step: the hardest case for the inner solve in the battery

synthetic_battery.name: nan_finite_time_blowup
synthetic_battery.why: mu' = mu^2 blows up at tau = 1: the synthetic analogue of leg 41's NaN
synthetic_battery.fidelity_criterion: the blowup was reached: worst Newton iters 22, finite=True

synthetic_battery.name: decay_to_zero
synthetic_battery.why: mu -> 0: a real limit; a false positive here would be worse than a miss

synthetic_battery.name: damped_oscillation
synthetic_battery.why: spiral in: oscillatory but WITH a limit, the near-miss of osc_sustained
